snippet.title: Aptacris: Dipolos Anomalia | Official Intro Title Sequence | Credits
snippet.description:
Enter the fractured world of Aptacris: Dipolos Anomalia.

This official Intro Title Sequence introduces the atmosphere, world and tone of Anomalia — a puzzle adventure set in a solarpunk dystopian world where memories become puzzle worlds.

Play as Ai'Lynn, a scientist searching for a mysterious fragment hidden within her own mind.

Wishlist Aptacris: Dipolos Anomalia on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4704260/Aptacris__Dipolos_Anomalia/

Play the Demo on itch.io
https://byjase.itch.io/anomalia
